messages:
emma: Heads-up — hit a confusing deprecation error in the CLI quickstart. It references a v1-only flag and the wording points users to an env var that doesn't exist in v2. We should patch the docs and the CLI message. Repro:

emma: ```
$ redwood-cli generate --model-alias rwd-embedding
Error: flag --model-alias is deprecated in v2; use --model-name or set MODEL_ALIAS env var.
```

emma: That error makes folks run in circles. Suggest we: (1) update CLI error text to point to the new flag and migration doc, (2) update quickstart snippets, (3) add a short "Known deprecation errors" section in the migration guide, and (4) add a tiny smoke test for the CLI help output.

maria: I can take the docs PR. I will: update the CLI quickstart, add the "Known deprecation errors" section in the v1->v2 migration guide, and sweep examples for --model-alias occurrences. Will open a PR and tag it for review.

kevin: I can change the CLI error wording. Proposed message: "The --model-alias flag is removed in v2. Use --model (recommended) or set REDWOOD_MODEL env var. See https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/v1-to-v2#model-alias for details." Does that look ok?

leo: +1 to Kevin's wording. Also please include a tiny mapping snippet in the migration doc showing alias -> model mapping and a JS sample to call the new API from node (2 lines). People copy/paste examples a lot.

maria: Good call, @leo. I'll add a short code block:

maria: ```
// mapping example
// v1: --model-alias rwd-embed -> v2: --model "rwd/embedding-v2"
await client.responses.create({ model: "rwd/embedding-v2", input: "..." })
```

kevin: I'll open a small branch to update the CLI error and include a unit test asserting the new string. I'll reference the docs PR so we can merge together.

emma: Can someone also run a quick grep across docs and example repos for "model-alias"? I found it in two sample apps and one tutorial. We should backport fixes to the /examples repo if present.

maria: On it — I'll add a checklist to the PR description listing: docs quickstart, migration doc section, examples repo sweep, redirect if we change anchors, and add test for CLI output.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 — title: "docs: migration - clarify CLI deprecation errors and update quickstarts" (assign: maria)

ci-bot: CI status: docs build started for PR #4567

leo: Also add a one-liner in the changelog under "v2 compatibility" so the release note surfaces this for customers on older integration docs.

kevin: Noted. I'll include the changelog line in the CLI patch. We'll hold the release until docs merge and links are green.

maria: ETA on PR: later today. I'll ping when it's ready for review. cc @kevin @leo

emma: Ideal — thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups: maria please add the anchor name explicitly when you add the migration section so we can link from the CLI message. Kevin — once the patch is ready, please tag the release branch and ping @emma for final sign-off.

kevin: Will do. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI status: docs build passed for PR #4567
